purpose: Shared wall materials and separate corner tower components

sources.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a new production component for a modular top-down historical RTS wall kit. The reference supplies only the polished hand-painted material finish and overhead camera, not its whole settlement composition. Camera exactly vertical nadir, orthographic roof-plan projection: zero visible vertical wall faces, no isometric tilt, no front elevation, no horizon. Rich restrained earthy colors and crisp broad readable construction, designed for 24–48 pixel terrain cells. No people, weapons, writing, letters, labels, flags, UI, borders or watermark. Create ONE isolated single sharpened timber palisade post TOP, viewed directly along its vertical axis from above. It is a round wood footprint with slightly irregular dark bark around its perimeter and a warm ochre/golden carved wood pointed cap. Three or four subtly faceted slopes converge at a small central point, giving a recognizable sharpened stake tip in plan view. No visible upright shaft, no perspective cylinder, no ring of posts, no tower, no surrounding ground. Weathered timber grain, short symmetrical ambient occlusion immediately around the post only; no long directional cast shadow. A single complete clean cutout centered on a square canvas, object fills about 70% of canvas, generous genuine transparent margins.

Rich restrained earthy colors and crisp broad readable construction, designed for 24–48 pixel terrain cells. No people, weapons, writing, letters, labels, flags, UI, borders or watermark. Create ONE small square timber watchtower fighting platform from STRICTLY DIRECTLY OVERHEAD. A sturdy raised square platform of tightly fitted weathered honey-brown timber planks, square low wood parapet rail top faces around the four sides, four large round sharpened timber post TOPS at the four platform corners. The corners/posts are physically attached to the platform, no disconnected framing. Open uncovered plank floor in the center, a small square ladder-hatch opening with a couple of visible wooden step top surfaces near the inner edge, no people or props. No straw roof, no vertical shafts, no tower wall elevations, no ladders hanging outside. This is a square roof-plan footprint, not an upright tower model. Fine wood grain, stout readable corner posts, warm rustic palisade materials. Short restrained contact shadow from upper-left light, no long shadow. The complete square tower footprint fills 74% of canvas width and height, centered, equal transparent margins. Genuinely transparent outside the footprint; no surrounding ground, trees or settlement.
